All 7 tests pass. Here's what was fixed:

1. **`overlaps`** — Changed `<=` to `<` on line 13 so touching intervals (e.g. `(540,600)` and `(600,660)`) no longer count as overlapping.
2. **`merge_intervals`** — Line 21: `intervals.sort()` was mutating the argument; changed to `sorted(intervals)` which returns a new list. Line 24: Changed `start < merged[-1][1]` to `start <= merged[-1][1]` so touching intervals get merged.
3. **`find_free_slots`** — Line 46: Changed `>` to `>=` so a gap of exactly `min_len` qualifies. Added the missing trailing window check (after the last busy interval up to `day_end`).
